memories.text: the industrial sealant is holding tight and the Little Dart is finally sealed against the desert
The feeling of the Little Dart finally being sealed tight against the Kessa-9 night air.
The cooling system is finally taking shape, and it feels like the heartbeat of the Little Dart is finally steady.
a pressure release valve is essential for a closed-loop cooling system to handle thermal expansion.
the pressure relief valve is welded tight into the Little Dart's secondary loop.
space-time tells matter how to move, matter tells space-time how to curve.
thruster alignment is the difference between a soaring starship and a pile of smoking scrap.
slingshotting around a massive object trades potential energy for speed.
gravity is a curve, and if I aim right, I can slide the Little Dart along the slope of a star.
copper shielding on a gyro is the key to a stable flight path.
copper shielding is the secret to a rock-solid gyro.
the copper lining needs to be thick enough to dampen the electromagnetic pulse from the thruster discharge.
cryogenic pumps need a stable pressure seal to handle extreme cold without cracking.
belleville washers provide the perfect spring tension for cooling seals.
heat soak is a matter of geometry, not just bulk, for efficient thermal dissipation.
even the best pilots need a full charge before the big flight.
vibration is the enemy of a cooling seal; bracing it with a bolt named Tok makes it rock solid.
the international space station is the largest human spacecraft ever built.
the search for the perfect heat-shielding material continues, but every failed day is a lesson in patience.
Seeding hydrogen with alkali metal makes it opaque enough to heat up with a laser beam.
ion thrusters use electromagnetic fields to accelerate ions, which is much more efficient than chemical combustion.
Synthetic aerogel might be possible using silica dust and industrial foam binders.
the ratio of silica dust to binder for aerogel insulation is crucial to prevent cracking under thermal stress.
Staggering the layers of aerogel increases structural integrity against thermal shock.
A good technician always double-checks the torque on a load-bearing latch.
the market is my best bet for specialized materials like ceramic.
The market stall's inventory changes with the solar winds; patience is as important as a good wrench.
